instruction: Set Chrome's minimum font size to 12 pixels to ensure text is always readable.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome's minimum font size to 12px. Custom getter reads webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size from Preferences. Custom metric checks exact value match. Similar complexity to default font size task but for minimum size setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts webkit.webprefs.minimum_font_size from Chrome Preferences file, which is the exact setting Chrome uses for minimum font size enforcement
Metric correctly handles rule parameter (receives rules dict directly from get_rule, not wrapped in type/rules structure) and performs exact value comparison
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting minimum font size to 12px, evaluator verifies minimum_font_size == 12
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to persist Preferences file changes and allows 3-second sleep for settings to load
Data flow is correct: getter returns {minimum_font_size: value} -> metric receives font_data with this structure -> compares against rule['value']
Edge cases handled: getter returns default value 0 on error with appropriate logging
Expected value (12) semantically matches instruction requirement exactly
